description: Search travel.art's calendar of art events — biennales, art fairs, festivals, major museum exhibitions. Returns dates, city, venues, ticket summary and prices by tier, status (scheduled / postponed / cancelled), last-verified date and a link to the travel.art guide. Ended events are excluded unless includePast is true or the date filters ask for the past. Use for 'when is documenta 16', 'art fairs in March 2027', 'what's on in London in October'.

activeOn.description: Only events running on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

endsBefore.description: Only events ending on or before this date. Optional.

includePast.description: Include events that have already ended. Default false.

query.description: Free text: event name, artist, theme, venue, city. Optional.

startsAfter.description: Only events starting on or after this date. Optional.

name: find_art_events
title: Find art events
